title: A Cop and a Coffee Cup
subtitle: Some Simple, Plain-Spoken Wisdom for Police Leadership in the 21st Century
shortDescription: A veteran chief's plain-spoken take on police leadership — practical wisdom for inspiring officers, building community trust, and leading with integrity.
longDescription: Drawing on decades in Northeast Ohio law enforcement, Tom Wetzel lays out straightforward, field-tested guidance for police leaders: motivating officers, building trust with the community, and leading with accountability on and off duty. Written like a conversation over coffee rather than a training manual, it's aimed at current and aspiring leaders who want to move policing culture in a better direction.
pullQuote: A conversation as natural as two cops would have over a cup of joe.
